text:
oncall-bot: PAGER: billing-metering anomaly detected — token emission vs ledger mismatch in EU1 starting ~02:12 UTC. Auto-severity: P2. Tags: metering, emit, billing.
alice (eng-oncall): seeing +15% token delta on the shadow emitter aggregate. dashboards show emit backlog spikes at 02:10-02:20.
raj (billing-sre): confirming, ingest-side reports many small batches stuck in SQS -> requeued later. suspect orphaned batch index/commit race.
sabrina (cs-ops): we got 3 customer overage alerts (acct: org-912, org-334, org-440) — customers emailed, CS triaging.
matt (eng-runtime): quick check: runtime logs show KV cache misses and emit retries: `WARN emitter retry=4 batch_id=0x7f9c tokens=812`. attaching snippet.
alice (eng-oncall): can someone run a manual reconcile for last 30m window and flag any negative deltas? SQL I usually run: `SELECT window_start, emitted, ledger_count FROM metering.window_agg WHERE window_start >= now()-interval '40 minutes'`.
raj (billing-sre): running now. preliminary: window 02:10 UTC emitted=1,234,567 ledger=1,123,004 delta=111,563. looks like emit>ledger (some batches never committed).
julian (incidents-lead): impact: potential customer-visible overages; set comms. Sabrina please prepare a short customer note. I'll set status page to "investigating".
sabrina (cs-ops): on it, draft ready. will wait for confirmation on which orgs to notify with estimated ETA.
matt (eng-runtime): mitigation idea: temporarily disable async emitter retries for shadow path (not primary) and promote the synchronous fallback so commits are forced. config toggle: `feature.emit_shadow_retries = false`
alice (eng-oncall): runbook step 4 says that toggle is safe for 15m windows. Raj, can you coordinate flip and monitor ledger catch-up?
raj (billing-sre): flipping shadow retry toggle now on eu1-stage -> `kubectl set env deployment/emitter EMIT_SHADOW_RETRIES=false -n prod-eu1`
(automated): deploy-bot: rollout started for deployment/emitter in prod-eu1, revision v2.14.3 -> v2.14.4.
alice (eng-oncall): after flip, emit retries dropped, backlog draining. ledger catching up — delta reduced from 111k -> ~4k in 6 min.
julian (incidents-lead): good. set P1->P2? keep pager open until ledger delta <1k for 30m. Sabrina notify the three orgs with interim note: "we are actively reconciling counts; temporary overage flags may be false positives; we will follow up with corrected invoices if needed."
sabrina (cs-ops): sending now. copy: "We’re aware of a metering anomaly in EU1 that may have triggered incorrect overage alerts between 02:10-02:25 UTC. Engineering is reconciling counts; we expect resolution within 1 hour. We will follow up with any corrections."
tess (oncall-next): I'll take next 1hr watch. handover checklist: monitor `metering.window_agg` delta, watch deploy-bot, and confirm backfill job starts if needed.
alice (eng-oncall): handover noted. created incident ticket IN-19876, linked to billing-recon job. action items: (1) raj to run backfill for orphaned batches, (2) matt to produce postmortem root cause (batch commit race), (3) cs to send customer followups.
raj (billing-sre): starting backfill now: `python tools/backfill.py --from 2023-09-10T02:00Z --to 2023-09-10T03:00Z --scope eu1` — ETA ~45m.
alice (eng-oncall): thanks. leave pager open, but I'm downgrading to monitor-only in 10m and handing to tess.
julian (incidents-lead): nice work. please include the emitter retry metrics and kvcache miss rate in postmortem graphs. Also consider adding a short term alert: `metering.delta > 50k AND window_age < 1h` to catch earlier. :thumbsup:
(automated): incident-bot: severity changed to P2 by julian.
tess (oncall-next): taking over. will ping if delta resurges.
alice (eng-oncall): resolved: ledger delta stable <1k at 02:58 UTC, backfill in progress. closing live pager here, will follow up in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
